INFISICAL_TOKEN.description: Infisical access token for the secret store. Sentinel "mock" selects the mock Infisical client (returns env fallbacks / placeholders).

INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID.description: Infisical project id. Optional when INFISICAL_TOKEN is "mock".

INFISICAL_ENVIRONMENT.description: Infisical environment slug (e.g. dev, staging, prod). Optional when INFISICAL_TOKEN is "mock".
